title: Serial Console
summary: A serial console that finds USB-serial adapters and tells what is behind them.
description: Names the adapter or board from its USB ids (FTDI, CP210x, CH340, PL2303, Arduino, ESP32, Pico and more), listens to or, after a confirmation, probes the other end to recognise common firmware and boot loaders, finds the speed and remembers the settings per port. Terminal with a control-key toolbar, logging and reconnect. Needs a USB-serial adapter or board and the user in the dialout group.
